strategicThesis: Big players can copy UI and LLM wrappers in weeks — they cannot copy closed-loop decision outcomes, partner economics, and calibrated scoring without 12–18 months of operational debt. Defend the Decision Platform layer, not feature parity.

defensibilityVerdict.narrativeForInvestors: We win when copycats ship chat without dispatch, CRM closure, or outcome-weighted scores.

attackScenarios.name: Sahibinden launches listing AI
attackScenarios.theirPlay: GPT layer on listings: 'hangi araç', price hints, dealer chat — keeps users in inventory funnel
attackScenarios.counterNarrative: Listeleyici AI ≠ karar motoru — arama orada, karar isteBul'da

attackScenarios.name: Bank adds in-app credit comparison
attackScenarios.theirPlay: Single-bank or consortium rate tables inside mobile app; push own origination
earlySignals: Sponsored APR widgets in auto apps
attackScenarios.counterNarrative: Bank sells one product — we show total ownership + fit across offers

attackScenarios.name: Generic AI enters automotive vertical
attackScenarios.theirPlay: ChatGPT/Gemini plugins, 'car advisor' GPTs, free conversational recommendations
attackScenarios.counterNarrative: Sayılar motor, AI anlatır — Pro history + partner closure

attackScenarios.name: New VC-backed decision/auto startup
attackScenarios.theirPlay: Clone wizard + scoring UX; burn on paid + dealer BD; undercut CPL
attackScenarios.counterNarrative: Ops moat + outcome data — they ship v1, we ship closed loop

attackScenarios.name: Arabam bundles AI + dealer CRM
attackScenarios.theirPlay: Integrated listing + 'TCO estimate' + dealer lead routing inside their stack
whatTheyMiss: Pro decision history portable off platform
attackScenarios.counterNarrative: Neutral decision infrastructure — not dealer-biased scoring

attackScenarios.name: Marketplace adds decision tab (Trendyol-style)
attackScenarios.theirPlay: High-traffic app adds 'smart buy' for big-ticket categories
attackScenarios.counterNarrative: High-consideration specialist beats generic shopping AI

defensePlans.name: Product defense
principles: LLM cannot override score or price — enforce in code + tests
Ship category registry + decision_leads before new verticals
Comparison-store + confidence tiers visible on every result
plays: Anti-copy checklist in AI_DECISION_ENGINE.md — public methodology
Wizard completion <3 min mobile; export PDF Pro
Feature flags to accelerate exclusivity-only partner routes

ifAttacked.sahibinden_ai: Ship side-by-side 'listing AI vs decision engine' landing within 14d
ifAttacked.generic_ai_auto: Launch 'verified numbers' badge + methodology strip A/B
ifAttacked.vc_backed_rival: Accelerate registry MVP; do not chase vanity features

defensePlans.name: Data defense
principles: Outcome graph is the moat — actual_revenue on every closed lead
plays: Mandatory partner outcome feedback; scoring weight monthly calibration
Exclusive TR auto feed LOI — block clone data parity
Publish 'models that closed in 14d' SEO once N>100

ifAttacked.bank_credit_compare: Deepen finance_offers freshness + asset-context API narrative
ifAttacked.vc_backed_rival: Do not disclose raw scoring weights; accelerate outcome density

defensePlans.name: Growth defense
principles: Own consideration SEO before they buy keywords
CAC payback gate — do not match clone burn blindly
plays: Triple down TCO + 'hangi araç' content cluster
Retargeting on wizard abandon with methodology proof
Limit paid if funnel CR drops >20% QoQ (signal of AI substitution)

ifAttacked.sahibinden_ai: Launch affiliate 'search there decide here' co-marketing with dealers
ifAttacked.generic_ai_auto: YouTube/SEO 'ChatGPT yanlış fiyat verir' evidence content
ifAttacked.vc_backed_rival: Partner co-traffic deals over paid keyword wars

defensePlans.name: Brand defense
principles: Trust beats feature checklists in TR high-consideration
Own 'Decision Platform' category name in PR
plays: Press: neutral advisor vs marketplace AI
Customer proof: Pro PDF + decision history
KVKK/GDPR-forward trust page EN for intl credibility

ifAttacked.generic_ai_auto: Influencer audits: same prompt, isteBul vs ChatGPT numbers

defensePlans.name: Partner defense
principles: Partners lose if they multi-home without data feedback
plays: Win-rate dashboard per partner; delist bad actors
EN partner kit + HMAC docs as BD weapon vs clones

ifAttacked.bank_credit_compare: Position as lead router to banks, not bank competitor
ifAttacked.arabam_ai_bundle: Neutral dispatch — dealers keep isteBul route for qualified score

defensePlans.name: Distribution defense
principles: Embed decision where inventory already lives
Dealer sends traffic to decision, not more listings
API/partner pack for B2B2C — clones lack production ops
plays: Widget/embed POC on dealer sites (decision CTA)
Partner API beta for CRM ingest — switching cost

ifAttacked.sahibinden_ai: Do not build listings — double dealer embed + SEO hub
ifAttacked.vc_backed_rival: Bundle Pro + dispatch in partner contract
ifAttacked.marketplace_super_app: Decline shallow integration; deepen auto beachhead

responsePlaybook.name: Detect (week 0–2)
actions: Monitor competitor SEO + App Store + dealer BD chatter
CEO alert if funnel CR -20% WoW or dispatch success <85%
Log attack scenario id in decision-log when triggered

responsePlaybook.name: Respond (week 2–8)
actions: Execute priority pillar ifAttacked plays from defensePlans
Freeze scope: no new vertical until beachhead metrics green

responsePlaybook.name: Compound (month 3–12)
actions: Outcome graph publication + partner exclusivity scale
Series A narrative: defensible company, not feature startup

warGameMatrix.doNotDo: Burn on paid CAC arms race
